limitations: The journal lacks full release-time consumer attempt/session identity.
No freed-index list binds those exact pages to consumer allocation.
Run-batch entry is not CUDA kernel start or time saved.
Released bytes are cumulative associations, not simultaneous free capacity.

shared_path_timing.clock: perf_counter_ns; CPU wall intervals, not GPU kernel time
shared_path_timing.scope: cumulative completed calls; exclusive totals avoid nested double counting

opportunity_writer_timing.scope: Every 64th record per category, starting with its first record. Measured processing samples only; queue waiting and status publication are excluded. Wall includes scheduling and GIL waiting; thread CPU excludes waiting. No full-run cost, GPU stall, GIL attribution or JCT saving is inferred.

limitations: Service and release associations do not establish a causal module speedup.
Changed Full configurations are not independent repeated trials.
Worker intervals include runtime and waits; fixed-work output throughput depends on makespan.
Sampled GPU/admission waits are not expanded or subtracted from JCT.
Verified copied/reused bytes do not establish hidden GPU time or removable JCT.
No progressive layer-capacity handoff ran in this experiment.
